description.narrative: (Pakistan): .The Building Peace in Pakistan activity will address drivers of conflict in Pakistan. In view of the devastation caused by the catastrophic 2022 floods in Pakistan, USIP will focus its programming on flood-affected areas to address potential risks of conflict in these areas due to unmet service delivery for marginalized groups. The activity will also seek to identify through research, convening, and scoping activities, key potential drivers of conflict due to the uncertain political climate in Pakistan and design interventions that can help develop a proof of concept for innovative approaches that can work in these areas. .. ..Under the Women in Peace and Security (WPS) component, the activity will focus on women's empowerment and provide support to at-risk women through specific programmatic interventions. It will engage the relevant government institutions to support the implementation and refinement of the National Gender Policy Framework and simultaneously build consensus at the provincial and local levels for more meaningful participation of women in all processes. This would feed into the broader goal of the UN and its member states for developing a national action plan on WPS in line with the UNSCR 1325. .. ..This IM contributes $500,000 to the Democracy, Human Rights and Governance earmark, $500,000 to the Gender earmark, and $500,000 to the Gender - Women, Peace and Security earmarks. .. .
